title: experiment.run_requested (v1)
description: ResearchOrchestrator instructs RunnerAgent to run the frozen ExperimentPatch under the frozen VerifierSpec's protocol (RunningExperiment state, state machine V1.10). RunnerAgent's RunningExperiment mode is M11 -- this is the frozen contract only; no consumer wired yet.

experiment_patch_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen ExperimentPatch object to be run.

verifier_spec_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen VerifierSpec object whose protocol governs the run.

benchmark_spec_ref.description: Opaque ref to the BenchmarkSpec whose evaluation semantics guide this run.

method_ref.description: Concrete confirmed Method ref whose execution feedback this run may update.

spec_interpretation_ref.description: Optional SpecInterpretation carrying a survey validation study.

recover_completed_result.description: True only for explicit process-restart redrive; permits recovery behind the durable remote session lock.
